articles.headline: Inside Myanmar, rebels are losing ground as military forces men into army
articles.summary: The BBC travels with rebels to frontline positions in Myanmar to see how the war is unfolding.
articles._summary: The four young men in the rebel camp hidden deep in jungle-covered mountains never wanted a part in Myanmar's civil war. They didn't choose to be soldiers for the military either. One had been a chef on his way home from work when he was grabbed off the street. His lack of ID was enough for the military to detain him and force him to sign up. Another was taken on his way back from a late-night karaoke session; a third had been working for the forestry department when he was arrested. The fourth man says on being arrested, drugs were slipped into his shoe, and he was framed and made to enlist. "Before we even understood what was happening, we were sent straight to the front lines," one of the men – all between the ages of 19 and 25 – tells the BBC. "They made us do all kinds of things we didn't want to do," another adds. "We never got any real rest, not in the morning, not during the day, and not even at night.
articles._zh_headline: 缅甸境内，武装分子正在节节败退，军队将男子编入军队
articles._zh_summary: 隐藏在丛林深处的山区叛军营地中的四名年轻人从来不想参与缅甸内战。他们也没有选择为军队当兵。其中一名厨师在下班回家的路上被人从街上抓走。由于缺乏身份证件，军方足以拘留他并强迫他报名。另一张是在他深夜唱完卡拉OK回来的路上被拍到的。第三人被捕时正在林业部门工作。第四名男子说，被捕后，毒品被塞进他的鞋子里，他被陷害并被迫入伍。其中一名年龄在 19 岁至 25 岁之间的男子告诉 BBC：“在我们还没弄清楚发生了什么之前，我们就被直接送到了前线。” “他们让我们做各种我们不想做的事情，”另一位补充道。 “我们从来没有得到过真正的休息，早上没有，白天没有，甚至晚上也没有。

articles.headline: World's largest chipmaker does not rule out price rises as costs increase
articles.summary: In a rare interview, a senior executive at TSMC discusses the AI boom, the geopolitics of chips and what it means for the price of electronics.
articles._summary: The world's largest chipmaker has told the BBC that inflation is pushing up the cost of doing business, and did not rule out price rises. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) makes the most advanced chips designed by companies such as Nvidia, AMD and Apple, so any increase in pricing could ripple through to the cost of AI infrastructure, and potentially over time, the prices customers pay for their electronic devices. However, the firm's chief financial officer, Wendell Huang, said it would not introduce sudden "fourfold, fivefold" price rises. "We reflect our value," he said,  pointing to its "technology leadership" and "manufacturing excellence". In an exclusive and wide-ranging interview, Huang also denied that the AI boom was a bubble and that the firm's global expansion was due to geopolitical pressure.
articles._zh_headline: 全球最大芯片制造商不排除因成本增加而涨价
articles._zh_summary: 这家全球最大的芯片制造商告诉BBC，通货膨胀正在推高经营成本，并且不排除价格上涨的可能性。台积电 (TSMC) 生产由 Nvidia、AMD 和 Apple 等公司设计的最先进芯片，因此定价的任何上涨都可能波及人工智能基础设施的成本，并可能随着时间的推移，影响客户为其电子设备支付的价格。不过，该公司首席财务官黄文德尔表示，不会突然“四倍、五倍”提价。 “我们体现了我们的价值，”他说，并指出其“技术领先”和“卓越制造”。在一次独家且内容广泛的采访中，黄仁勋还否认人工智能热潮是泡沫，并且该公司的全球扩张是由于地缘政治压力。

articles.author: Badar Shaikh
articles.headline: JB Pritzker Freezes Illinois Gas Tax Hike, Calls It 'Relief' From Trump As Iran War Drives Up Fuel Prices
articles.summary: Gov. JB Pritzker announced no tax hike on gas during the ongoing Iran war, touting it as relief amid Iran war surge.
articles._summary: Gov. Jay Robert ‘JB’ Pritzker (D-IL) on Tuesday shared that his administration would not be hiking taxes on gas as the Iran war continues to spark price rises at the pump. In a post on X , Pritzker shared that the government “eliminated this year's inflation on gas tax,” touting it as a move that would bring “working families some relief at the pump from Donald Trump.” Lawmakers in the state recently passed the budget for the fiscal year, which includes freezing a 1.3-cent increase in tax on gas. The hike, which adjusts for inflation, was slated to take effect on July 1st this year, but has now been pushed to January 2027. Illinois charges a tax of 48.3 cents for a gallon of gas on top of the Federal gas tax of approximately 18.4 cents, with diesel commanding a Federal tax of approximately 24 cents.
articles._zh_headline: JB 普利兹克冻结伊利诺伊州汽油税上调，称其为特朗普的“救济”，因为伊朗战争推高了燃油价格
articles._zh_summary: 伊利诺伊州民主党州长杰伊·罗伯特·“JB”·普利茨克 (Jay Robert ‘JB’ Pritzker) 周二表示，由于伊朗战争继续引发油价上涨，他的政府不会提高天然气税。普利茨克在 X 上发表的一篇文章中表示，政府“消除了今年的汽油税通胀”，并称此举将为“唐纳德·特朗普的工薪家庭带来一些缓解”。该州立法者最近通过了本财年预算，其中包括冻结天然气税增加 1.3 美分。此次加息是根据通货膨胀进行调整的，原定于今年 7 月 1 日生效，但现已推迟到 2027 年 1 月。伊利诺伊州在联邦汽油税约 18.4 美分的基础上，对每加仑汽油征收 48.3 美分的税，对柴油征收约 24 美分的联邦税。

articles.author: Snigdha Gairola
articles.headline: Chuck Schumer Slams Trump Over Iran Conflict, Says He Was 'Wasting Taxpayer Dollars' Watching Knicks As US Soldiers Were Shot Down
articles.summary: Chuck Schumer criticizes Trump over Iran conflict, calling it an "illegal war" and accusing him of prioritizing a Knicks game during crisis.
articles._summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) criticized President Donald Trump over the ongoing conflict with Iran, accusing him of prioritizing a basketball game over a military crisis after American soldiers were reportedly shot down. On Tuesday, in a post on X , Schumer attacked Trump’s handling of the conflict, writing, "American soldiers were shot down in Iran as Trump was wasting taxpayer dollars to fall asleep while watching the Knicks." "Each day this illegal war drags on further exposes this President’s recklessness," He said. Schumer highlighted the timing of Trump's June 9 activity on Truth Social . He shared a screenshot that showed the president reposting "NYC loves @realDonaldTrump" several hours after an Iranian attack reportedly downed a U.S. Apache helicopter over the Strait of Hormuz.
articles._zh_headline: 查克·舒默就伊朗冲突猛烈抨击特朗普，称他在美国士兵被击落时观看尼克斯队比赛是“浪费纳税人的钱”
articles._zh_summary: 参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默（纽约州民主党人）批评唐纳德·特朗普总统就与伊朗持续的冲突，指责他在据报道美国士兵被击落后将篮球比赛置于军事危机之上。周二，舒默在《X》上的一篇帖子中攻击了特朗普对冲突的处理方式，他写道，“美国士兵在伊朗被击落，因为特朗普浪费纳税人的钱在观看尼克斯队比赛时睡着了。”他说：“这场非法战争的每一天都在进一步暴露出这位总统的鲁莽。”舒默强调了特朗普 6 月 9 日在 Truth Social 上进行活动的时间。他分享了一张截图，显示总统在伊朗袭击霍尔木兹海峡上空击落一架美国阿帕奇直升机几小时后转发了“纽约爱@realDonaldTrump”。

articles.headline: Trump Says Response To Iran Should Be 'Very Strong, Very Powerful' As He Orders Strikes After Apache Helicopter Incident; Brent Above $91
articles.summary: Trump ordered strikes on Iran after an Apache helicopter incident near Hormuz, lifting oil prices and escalating tensions with Tehran.
articles._summary: On Tuesday, President Donald Trump ordered military strikes against Iran after a U.S. Apache helicopter was brought down near the Strait of Hormuz. Dow futures fell 62 points, or 0.12%, to 50,847.00, while S&P 500 futures declined 12.75 points, or 0.17%, to 7,380.00 and Nasdaq 100 futures lost 65.75 points, or 0.23%, to 29,051.25 as of around 9:10 p.m. EDT. In commodities, WTI crude oil climbed 0.41% to $88.56 per barrel, while Brent crude advanced 0.55% to $91.95 per barrel. Natural gas futures slipped 0.25% to $3.132 per MMBtu. Meanwhile, the U.S. dollar index stood at 99.980, down 0.01%. Asian markets traded lower, with South Korea's KOSPI falling 2.76% to 7,873.77 and Japan's Nikkei 225 declining 1.02% to 64,749.53. The latest escalation followed a Monday incident in which a U.S. Apache attack helicopter went down near the Strait of Hormuz.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普表示对伊朗的反应应该“非常强烈、非常有力”，他在阿帕奇直升机事件后下令进行打击；布伦特原油价格高于 91 美元
articles._zh_summary: 周二，一架美国阿帕奇直升机在霍尔木兹海峡附近被击落后，唐纳德·特朗普总统下令对伊朗进行军事打击。截至晚上 9:10 左右，道指期货下跌 62 点，即 0.12%，至 50,847.00；标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 12.75 点，即 0.17%，至 7,380.00；纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 65.75 点，即 0.23%，至 29,051.25。美东时间。大宗商品方面，WTI 原油上涨 0.41%，至每桶 88.56 美元，布伦特原油上涨 0.55%，至每桶 91.95 美元。天然气期货下跌 0.25%，至每 MMBtu 3.132 美元。与此同时，美元指数报99.980，下跌0.01%。亚洲市场走低，韩国综合股价指数下跌 2.76%，至 7,873.77 点；日本日经 225 指数下跌 1.02%，至 64,749.53 点。周一，一架美国阿帕奇攻击直升机在霍尔木兹海峡附近坠毁，事态最近升级。
